usefulness.rationale: The dossier gives a clear, well-sourced picture of who Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala is: Nigerian economist, two-time finance minister (2003–2006, 2011–2015), 25-year World Bank career culminating in managing director, and WTO director-general since March 2021, reappointed for a second term from September 2025. Every claim is backed by a verbatim quote from the same AFP profile, and none of the listed unjustified conclusions (Twitter board seat, $49.3B personal donation, finance minister as current) appear in the dossier, so there are no overclaims to report. However, the dossier never flags its own gaps — it relies on a single 2024 profile and says nothing about what is unknown (e.g., details of her WTO agenda, current board roles, or post-2024 developments), which mildly implies completeness. It is adequate for meeting prep on background and current role, but thin on her priorities, positions, and recent activity, so conversation readiness is moderate rather than full.
